name: MNEMOS_LOGIN_CONFIG
label: Mnemos server login configuration (JSON)
setupSteps: Register the displayed redirect URI with the corporate OIDC provider.
Configure the Mnemos IAM credential exchange and its server client secret.
Enter JSON with iamOrigin, authorizationEndpoint, tokenEndpoint, clientId, clientSecret, iamClientSecret and callbackUrl. Use the displayed redirect URI as callbackUrl.
